scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Backlund again for Lanevus; the Hornacis peak palace with its vertical pupil of symbols): both enemies and Klein's opportunities point to Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: So Ince Zangwill has gone to Backlund

scenes.setting: Out of the cemetery like a wandering ghost: past Dunn's grave, past the house he can't knock on, to sleep rough under his jacket
scenes.text_anchor: When he returned to the material world, he slowly walked out of his hiding spot

scenes.setting: Woken by a constable's baton — the Poor Law doesn't allow vagrants on the streets; the dead hero walks until daybreak
scenes.text_anchor: It wasn't long into his sleep when he was suddenly woken by someone.

scenes.setting: Backlund Bank withdrawal by password, a full new wardrobe, and a second-class ticket on the two o'clock train to Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: Soon after, he lowered his head and entered the Tingen branch of the Backlund Bank.

scenes.setting: The waiting area's emptiness pulls him back to Daffodil Street one last time, hiding in the shade across from the door he can't cross to
scenes.text_anchor: Klein suddenly had an empty feeling in his heart

scenes.setting: The circus in the municipal square: trailing his grieving siblings — then a pastel-faced clown conjures a golden Seville Chrysanthemum, the flower of happiness, and offers it with a wide, ridiculous smile. (End of Volume 1)
scenes.text_anchor: Suddenly, he saw the door to the house open as Melissa and Benson came out.
